label: Cubans paid two thousand dollars each to go and fight
description: Cubans offered two thousand dollars a head to fight, against an average Cuban wage he gives as twenty dollars a month, with a headquarters established there as a front for another Cuban missile crisis and Cuba drawn to Russia by promises of BRICS membership and escape from the Western boot. Reporting on Cuban recruits in the Russian army had been public since 2023, and Cuba became a BRICS partner country in January 2025.

label: Revival on named American campuses
description: A major revival called for and seen on the college campuses, with Harvard, Princeton, Yale, USC, Oklahoma and Florida named, alongside instructions to pray over Alabama, Texas and the campuses generally.
aliases: from Harvard to Princeton to Yale

label: A revival from sea to sea in Canada, out of persecution
description: The giant of the church rising in Canada, signs and wonders, and a major revival from sea to sea coming out of persecution, which they will not be able to suppress or silence. The order, persecution then revival, is the checkable part.

label: A man in the Pentagon passing a deciphered message to Europe
description: Seen 6 October 2025: a man in the Pentagon taking a deciphered message and handing it to somebody in Europe, and from Europe onward. A named building and a named destination.
aliases: giving it to somebody in Europe

label: Lineages running back to the Aztec, the Maya and the Asian dragons
description: A lineage traced down into the Aztec and the Spanish and through South America, tied to human sacrifice and witchcraft around the pyramids and to the walls, with a separate Asian line he finds most fascinating involving the dragons. He says outright that this is way out there and that he never expected it.
